name: Straight
rule: Hits the first living enemy in its column, if within range.

name: Spread
rule: Hits the first enemy in its column and each neighbouring column, if within range.

name: Pierce
rule: Hits every living enemy in its column within range.

name: Boost
rule: Adds ATK (or range) to the attacker directly above it.

name: Cross Boost
rule: Adds its bonus to attackers on all 4 sides.

name: Multiplier
rule: Multiplies the ATK of the unit above (x2).

name: Spyglass
rule: Adds range to the unit above.

name: Shield
rule: Absorbs up to N enemy damage per turn in its column.

name: Plain
rule: No special rule; the stat line is the whole card.

name: Front-liner
rule: Straight with short range and high ATK; belongs in the front row.

name: Backline
rule: Works from the back row thanks to long or unlimited range.

name: Overkill (old global rule)
rule: Leftover damage from a Straight/Spread kill carries to the enemy behind. RECOMMENDATION: remove as a default rule; it becomes Rend.
note: Currently engine.js dealDamage; to be restricted.

name: Rend
rule: Leftover damage from this unit's kill carries to the enemy behind, capped at 3. Fangs' signature; any unit can gain it from the 2-Fangs set, items, relics and Camp.

name: Spill (relic/item rule)
rule: Rend leftover also spills to the front enemies beside the one that fell.

name: Herald
rule: Buffer: adjacent allies get +1 ATK; adjacent allies of the named family get +1 more (Kin bonus).

name: Element Herald
rule: Element buffer: adjacent allies get +1 ATK or +1 block; adjacent allies of the named element get +1 more (Kin bonus).

name: Attune
rule: The unit above takes this unit's element for the battle.

name: Mirror
rule: Copies the pattern and ATK of the unit to its left.

name: Column Captain
rule: Every attacker in its column gets +1 ATK.

name: Row Captain
rule: Every attacker in its row gets +1 ATK.

name: Molt
rule: Gains +1 ATK each turn it survives (max +3).

name: Offering
rule: On Fight, consumes one adjacent Common ally for the battle: +2 ATK. The ally returns next battle.

name: Latecomer
rule: +2 ATK if it was the last card you placed this turn.

name: Firstborn
rule: +2 ATK if it was the first card you placed this turn.

name: Swap
rule: After attacking, swaps places with an ally (stated on the card).

name: Resonance
rule: +1 to its main stat per other ally of its element (max +3).

name: Herd
rule: +1 to its main stat per other ally of its family (max +2).

name: Howl
rule: +1 ATK per other Fangs unit in its row (max +2).

name: Decoy
rule: Takes the first enemy strike in its column; Shield value applies.

name: Skyfall
rule: Straight with unlimited range.

name: Chain
rule: The same damage jumps to the lowest-HP enemy beside the target.

name: Mark
rule: The target is Marked: the next hit on it deals +1.

name: Hold
rule: The hit enemy cannot strike this turn.

name: Mimic
rule: Takes the element of the first enemy it hits until battle end.

name: Tribute
rule: +1 Soul for each kill.

name: Bloom
rule: Heals the hero 1 at the end of each turn.

name: Echo
rule: Attacks twice; the second hit deals half ATK (round up).

name: Echo Drum
rule: The unit above attacks twice (second hit at half ATK).

name: Brood
rule: Every 2nd turn spawns a 1-ATK Drone in an empty adjacent tile.

name: Carapace
rule: Shield value grows +1 each turn it is not struck (max +3).

name: Current
rule: The hit enemy is pushed one column sideways (swaps with whoever is there).

name: Scorch
rule: The hit enemy Burns: 1 damage at the end of each turn for 2 turns.

name: Chill
rule: Ice flavour: the hit enemy loses 1 ATK for the battle (min 1). An Ice hit on a Wet enemy Freezes it (skips its next strike).

name: Venom
rule: The hit enemy takes 1 poison each turn; stacks up to 3.

name: Trample
rule: Also deals 1 damage to the enemy behind the target (not overkill).

name: Pounce
rule: +2 damage against an enemy at full HP.

name: Swift
rule: Attacks before the front row does.

name: Bastion
rule: Shield and a short attack from the same tile.

name: Relay
rule: Boosts the unit above and the unit above that.

name: Sunder
rule: The hit enemy loses 1 armor for the battle.

name: Ward
rule: Negates the first strike against the hero each battle.

name: Rebirth
rule: Once per run, the hero rises at half HP.

name: Bond
rule: While its folklore partner is in the squad (on the board or not), both get +1 ATK.

name: Reaction
rule: Element pairs trigger a named effect on hit or when adjacent; 12 reactions, see elements.json.

name: Evolve
rule: At mastery and star thresholds the unit gains an extension; it never changes its fundamental type.

name: Mentor
rule: An adjacent unit of a lower stage counts as one stage higher for its extension this battle.

name: Armored N
rule: Each hit deals N less damage.

name: Barrel
rule: 1 HP; explodes for 2 to orthogonal neighbours and chains.

name: Healer
rule: Heals adjacent enemies 2 each turn.

name: Splitter
rule: Splits into two 1-HP enemies when destroyed.

name: Summoner
rule: Adds a minion to the nearest empty tile each turn.

name: Bulwark
rule: Armored. Blocks Pierce and Rend from passing to the tile behind it; a wide Bulwark blocks every column it covers.

name: Guarded
rule: Takes no damage while its guard lives. Rework: the guard's death removes the ward; no overkill needed.

name: Regrow
rule: Heads grow back once.

name: Hide
rule: Hits weaker than N do nothing.

name: Gaze
rule: Attackers in its column lose 1 ATK.

name: Sweep
rule: Also strikes both neighbouring columns for half damage (for a Big body: the columns beside the whole footprint).

name: Tide
rule: Rows drift sideways each turn (Heavy bodies do not drift and block the drift of their row).

name: Regenerate
rule: Heals about 12% HP each turn.

name: Fury
rule: +1 ATK per turn survived.

name: Harden
rule: +1 armor per turn (max 3).

name: Stride
rule: Sidesteps one column per turn (Heavy bodies never do).

name: Veiled
rule: Cannot be hurt on turn 1.

name: Enrage
rule: Surviving enemies get +1 ATK each turn.

name: Elemental variant
rule: Enemy carries an element from its bestiary variant (frost = Water/Ice, storm = Wind/Lightning); reactions apply to it.

name: Wet / Burning / Chilled / Frozen status
rule: Statuses set by reactions and flavours; they are what the reaction table reads on enemies.

name: Alpha
rule: Strengthens nearby kin (+1 ATK to same-family enemies beside it).

name: Ghost
rule: Plain hits do 1 less; Light and Purge reveal it.

name: Swarm
rule: Packs of 1-HP bodies; weak to Spread and Chain.

name: Corrupted
rule: Spreads blight: adjacent player tiles lose 1 boost until cleansed by Light.

name: Kin bonus
rule: A buffer's base effect reaches every ally in its area; allies of its own family (or element) get +1 more. Costs 1 budget point.

name: Kin only (exclusive buffer)
rule: Kin only: the buff reaches only allies of the buffer's own family or element, but is stronger (usually +2 and a wider area). Rare and strong; at most one per rarity band.

name: Ice (Water flavour)
rule: Water unit or enemy with Chill and Freeze: Chill -1 ATK, Freeze on a Wet target. Thawed by Fire (Steam).

name: Lightning (Wind flavour)
rule: Wind unit or enemy that Chains; on a Water or Wet target it chains for half damage (Conduct). Grounded by Earth.

name: Big body
rule: Elite or boss occupying more than one tile (footprint WxD: 2x1, 1x2, 2x2, 3x1). One HP pool, one ATK, one status set. Anchor = front-left tile.

name: Wide
rule: Width 2 or 3. Strikes once per covered column (a lane), ATK per lane, each lane absorbed by its own column's Shield. Hit from every covered column.

name: Deep
rule: Depth 2 (front and back row of one column). One lane; blocks both rows of its column. Pierce and Straight hit it once per attack.

name: Heavy
rule: All Big bodies: cannot be pushed, swapped, Stridden or drifted by Tide; immune to Current. Hold, Chill, Burn and Venom work normally.

name: Boss row (gate)
rule: Body in the extra third enemy row. Hit only through a column with no living enemy in rows 1-2 (the gate). Range counts it as the back row.

name: Per-column hits
rule: Each column an attack lands in is a separate hit on the target there: a Spread that reaches 2 tiles of one Big body deals its damage twice. Armor and reactions apply per hit.

name: Once per action
rule: Statuses (Burn, Venom, Chill, Mark, Hold) and area reactions apply once per attack action per body, however many columns hit it.
